product_family: Smartsheet AI: AI-powered collaborative work management platform including Smart Assist (in-product AI companion), Smart Columns (AI-enriched data at scale), AI Dashboard Builder, Natural Language Creation, MCP Connectors for third-party AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT), and Smart Agents (coming soon).

certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27001:2013 - Information Security Management. These certification audits were performed by an accredited third-party auditor and reviewed by a certification body.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27017:2015
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27017:2015 - Code of practice for information security controls for cloud services. These certification audits were performed by an accredited third-party auditor and reviewed by a certification body.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27018:2019
certifications.proof_quote: ISO/IEC 27018:2019 - Protection of personally identifiable information (PII) in public clouds. These certification audits were performed by an accredited third-party auditor and reviewed by a certification body.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 27701:2019
certifications.proof_quote: Smartsheet operates an ISO/IEC 27701:2019 compliant privacy program. ISO 27018:2019 and ISO 27701:2019 certifications align with GDPR requirements.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management System)

To enter into a BAA with Smartsheet, contact your Smartsheet account manager or submit the form to contact the Sales team.

certifications.name: FedRAMP Moderate
certifications.proof_quote: Smartsheet Gov has been granted a Moderate ATO by the FedRAMP PMO. Platform built on AWS GovCloud (US). Used by agencies such as the National Institutes of Health, National Parks Service, Library of Congress, and the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs.

certifications.name: DOD IL4 (Impact Level 4)
certifications.proof_quote: Smartsheet Gov has been granted Impact Level 4 (IL-4) PA by the Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA).

certifications.name: GDPR (compliance posture)
certifications.proof_quote: DPA is automatically incorporated into the Smartsheet User Agreement. Incorporates EU Standard Contractual Clauses. Participates in the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. ISO 27701:2019 certified privacy program.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: Smartsheet does not intend the use of the Offerings to be in compliance with the Payment Card Industry Security Standards. Explicitly excluded in the Acceptable Use Policy.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR registration or self-assessment found on vendor domain or CSA STAR Registry as of 2026-06-27.

privacy.ai_training_note: Contractual guarantee per AI page and Privacy FAQ: 'Your data never trains third-party foundation models, never mixes with other customers' data, and never leaves your control. This isn't just policy - it's a contractual guarantee.' Privacy FAQ confirms: 'No. We do not own your AI Data and do not use it to train public models.'
privacy.data_region: Three residency options per vendor data-residency docs: United States (backed up in the US), European Union (Germany, backed up in Ireland), and Australia (backed up in Australia). Region is determined at account creation via the regional login domain (smartsheet.com / smartsheet.eu / smartsheet.au). Specific AWS region names are not published by the vendor.

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS required for all connections; only encrypted connections to the online Service permitted for transfer of Customer Content.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: All Customer Content stored in encrypted form at rest within the online Services. Standards consistent with or exceeding NIST recommendations.

security.name: Access controls
security.value: Unique IDs per employee, principle of least privilege, 90-day access review cycles, account lockout on repeated failed attempts, MFA required for remote/VPN access.

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Annual external penetration testing by independent third-party security professionals. Pen Test Reports available to customers on written request.

security.name: Breach notification
security.value: Notification within 72 hours of confirming a Security Breach. Subprocessor notice period: 15 days advance notice.

security.name: Vulnerability / patch management
security.value: Ongoing programs to keep systems updated with latest patches, updates, and bug fixes. Anti-malware deployed and kept current.

security.name: AI architecture
security.value: Each AI request routes through Smartsheet's application layer to the model provider; no customer data retained by the AI model provider at any point. Usage logged separately for admin audit without exposing data to model partners. AWS used as cloud infrastructure partner for AI.

security.name: AI access controls
security.value: Admins control which AI features are enabled and for which users. User permissions enforced: if a user cannot access a sheet, the AI cannot either.

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Hosted on AWS. Smartsheet Gov on AWS GovCloud (US). EU region on AWS Frankfurt/Dublin. Disaster recovery program with annual testing.

products.name: Smartsheet (Commercial)
products.data_scope: Sheets, dashboards, reports, attachments, automations, AI-enriched columns. Data hosted in US, EU, or AU based on account region.
products.notes: Pro, Business, Enterprise tiers. HIPAA BAA available at Enterprise only. AI features availability varies by plan - may require add-on or Enterprise tier.

products.name: Smartsheet Gov
products.category: FedRAMP Moderate / DOD IL4 Government Work Management
products.data_scope: CUI and government data. Hosted on AWS GovCloud (US). Separate instance from commercial.
products.notes: FedRAMP Moderate ATO, DOD IL4 PA. Used by NIH, NPS, Library of Congress, VA. Separate product from commercial Smartsheet.

products.name: Smartsheet AI / Smart Assist
products.data_scope: Reads sheet data, project context, permissions enforced. No customer data retained by model provider.
products.notes: Built into Smartsheet platform. AI model provider not publicly named (AWS partnership noted). Customer data never trains third-party models.

products.name: Smartsheet MCP Server
products.data_scope: Exposes live Smartsheet work data to third-party AI tools (Claude, Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT) in real time via MCP protocol.
products.notes: Data filtering/compression applied before reaching third-party AI. Same compliance posture as core platform per vendor claims.

products.name: Smart Agents
products.data_scope: Project monitoring, risk surfacing, workflow execution. Human-in-the-loop approval built in.
products.notes: Announced as 'coming soon' as of 2026-06-27. Not yet generally available.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium with tiered subscriptions (Pro, Business, Enterprise, Advanced Work Management). AI features may require Enterprise tier or add-on. Smartsheet Gov is a separate government SKU.
compare.data_residency: US (backup US), EU (Germany, backup Ireland), Australia (backup Australia). Region determined at account creation via the regional login domain.

flags: Smartsheet states it is actively pursuing ISO 42001 certification on its Responsible AI page but is not yet certified. The AI homepage lists 'SOC 2, GDPR, data residency' alongside AI trust statements, which could be read as implying broader AI-governance certification than currently held.

HIPAA BAA is available for Enterprise plans covering the core Smartsheet platform (PHI Eligible Services). It is not publicly documented whether Smartsheet AI features (Smart Assist, MCP Server) are included in HIPAA BAA scope. Healthcare customers using PHI with AI features should confirm coverage before enabling AI capabilities.

The MCP Server routes live Smartsheet data to third-party AI models (Claude, Copilot, Gemini, ChatGPT). Smartsheet states data is filtered/compressed before reaching the model and no data is retained by providers. Security of the third-party model provider interaction is a shared-responsibility consideration that customers should review for their specific AI tool integrations.

The vendor's ISO compliance page lists ISO/IEC 27001:2013, not the 2022 revision. The 2026-03 security capabilities whitepaper references ISO 27001 without a year. ISO 27017:2015 is corroborated on the ISO compliance page and in the same whitepaper ('ISO/IEC 27001, 27017, & 27018').
Smart Agents are listed as 'coming soon' on the AI page and are not yet generally available.
